svg.title: The AI model landscape
svg.desc: Illustrative model profiles based on the supplied concept image. Five-axis radar charts use a common scale from zero to five.
svg.text: Illustrative model profiles / Five skills on a shared 0–5 scale

GPT-6.1 Sol — Reasoning 5, Coding 4, Speed 5, Multimodal 3, Affordability 3
GPT-6.1 Terra — Reasoning 3, Coding 3, Speed 4, Multimodal 4, Affordability 4

svg.text: Further out = higher score. For affordability, higher means cheaper.
